title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover thrashing
author: Samir Patel
description: Motivation: Production incident 2024-11-11 exposed a thrashing interaction between the SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover: when a region transiently exceeded error-rate thresholds the enforcer triggered aggressive backoff + cross-region failover, then recovered quickly, which led to repeated failover/flapping and downstream overloads. This PR stabilizes the enforcer by: 1) adding a minimum cool-down window before regional failover can be re-attempted for the same route/model; 2) making backoff increments additive with jitter and capping at a lower steady-state to avoid over-shedding; 3) adding a short-term hysteresis check (10s moving-window) to prevent reacting to single-spike bursts; and 4) a small telemetry change to emit explicit enforcer_state transitions to make postmortem root-cause analysis easier. Summary of changes: - control/slo_enforcer: introduce region_failover_cooldown_ms and hysteresis window checks; refactor backoff calculator to additive-with-jitter and cap to 3x base (was unbounded exponential in practice) - control/slo_enforcer/tests: add unit tests for hysteresis, cooldown, and backoff cap - control/routing: honor cooldown and avoid issuing duplicate regional failover commands within cooldown window - observability: new metric slo_enforcer.transition_count and tagging of transition_reason - configs: bump default cooldown to 30s and backoff_base to 2s with max 6s steady cap - integration test: add deterministic simulation that previously reproduced flapping scenario Related: ENG-4521 tracks long-term enforcer replumbing; SRE-1087 is the incident ticket. Risk: behavioral change to SLO enforcement; defaults tuned conservatively and feature gated (slo_enforcer.stability_mode=true) to allow staged rollout. Testing: unit tests added, integration sim included, ran canary in us-west-2 for 6 hours with no flapping under synthetic spike. Rollout plan: behind feature flag, enable on canary then 24h watch, then gradual rollout by region. Checklist: - [x] unit tests - [x] integration sim - [x] metric emitted - [x] config defaults reviewed - [x] on-call notified and postmortem stubbed for SRE-1087
